name: inject_v1
_comment: Supervised training on MANUFACTURED pairs. A group's deepest stack is the target; the input is that target plus a scaled field of the camera's own noise, built by cancelling the sky between two disjoint half-stacks. This is no longer Noise2Noise -- see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-24-noise-injection-training-design.md. It exists because at 250-450 frames there was nothing in the archive cleaner than Andreas' own stacks, so the lesson was empty and n2n_v2 learned to do nothing (55% of the noise removed on M45 where GraXpert removes 85%).
_comment_dataset: Selects data.InjectionDataset for TRAINING only. The do-no-harm gate keeps judging on the REAL held-out pairs the ladder below builds: manufactured data judging a model trained on manufactured data is a closed loop that cannot detect its own premise being wrong.
_comment_held_out: NEVER training material: M8 and M45 are Andreas' own masters and the only honest tests this project has; NGC6888 and NGC7000 are the gate's held-out pairs. NGC7000 replaced NGC281 on 2026-08-30 so NGC281's recovered 1514 frames could train -- the archive lost its deep S50 groups and NGC281 is the second-deepest thing left. NGC7000 keeps the light-polluted holdout the split needs (Helsingborg, SITELAT 56.150, against Crete's 35.3-35.5). M27 validates alone. build_injection.plan_groups refuses to build the held-out ones and data.split_injection_tiles refuses to load them.
_comment_sensor: `sensor` is the model's identity: stage() writes denoise_{sensor}_v1.onnx and the S30 Pro is the camera Nocturne targets. `sensors` WAS ['s30','s50'] because the S50 groups were the deep ones -- M42 2361 frames, SH2-142 1357, NGC7023 821 -- and a clean target has to come from somewhere deep. Every one of them died with Work2 on 2026-08-25 and none is recoverable; the archive is now entirely S30 Pro. Kept as a list so re-adding borrowed data later is a config change, not a code change.
_comment_ladder: Everything below drives the LADDER build, which this run needs only for the gate's real held-out pairs. The values are n2n_v2's unchanged, so those pairs -- and therefore every per-target gate metric -- stay comparable run to run.
_comment_source: The local archive recovered off the Seestar after the 2026-08-25 disk loss. NEVER the NAS: it holds the only surviving copy and training writes gigabytes (check_splits.refuse_nas enforces this).
_comment_depth: The 70% at 200-500 frames is now actually delivered. It was 19-23% until 2026-08-30 because the tile was chosen before the depth and every deep ask clamped down to what that tile could back; data.InjectionDataset.pick_tile inverts the order. Measured 70.1%, median depth 261 frames.
